Question:
A club with \(x\) members is organized into four committees in accordance with these two rules:

\((1)\) Each member belongs to two and only two committees.

\((2)\) Each pair of committees has one and only one member in common.

Then \(x:\)

Choices.B: has a single value between \(8\) and \(16\)
Choices.D: has a single value between \(4\) and \(8\)
